protocol.outer: patient-level 5-fold CV, fold seeds [0, 1, 2] (same assignments as step 1)
protocol.inner: calibration refit on training patients only: 5-fold out-of-fold GBM residuals, fold seeds [0, 1, 2]

methods.persistence_constant: last observed volume +/- conformal residual quantiles
methods.persistence_scaled: last observed volume, range scaled by the Poisson-GLM scale model
methods.gbm_scaled: GBM forecast, range scaled by the Poisson-GLM scale model (deployed)

protocol.units: log1p(mL); total = log1p(sum of compartment mL)
